thread:
tara: Hi folks, I'm tara and I'm shadowing on-call this week. I got PagerDuty web access but I'm not getting SMS/phone notifications. PD profile says phone unverified. Anyone seen this?

ben: welcome tara! :wave: Usually that means you need to verify your number in PD or complete MFA enrollment. Did you get an invite that ties PD to Okta/SSO?

tara: Yes I logged in via Okta. When I try to add a phone it errors with "verification failed - number blocked".

alex: That often comes from our phone-provisioning rule blocking non-company numbers. @ops-iam owns the PD/telephony policy. File a quick ticket or ping them here.

ops-iam: Hi @tara, can you DM me the exact phone country code? We whitelist +1, +44, +61 by default. If you're outside those, we need a short exceptions form. I just opened ticket OPS-1229.

tara: DMed the number. Thanks. Quick question on behavior: if I'm shadowing and can't be paged by SMS, is it OK to rely on Slack mentions for the drill?

ben: For practice drills Slack mentions are fine, but in real rotations we need at least one verified contact method (SMS or phone). If SMS not available, add a forwarding number or use the emergency fallback mobile listed in the runbook for critical pages.

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: Shadows must complete the access checklist before becoming primary. Checklist: PD notifications verified, IAM role 'oncall-shadow' assigned, jumpbox access confirmed. See https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/access-checklist

tara: noted. Another question: when is it appropriate to escalate to platform infra vs service owner for 5xx errors? runbook gave a few rules but I want a succinct decision rule.

alex: Succinct rule we use: if error pattern suggests upstream or infra (DB connection pool exhausted, network errors, auth service failures) -> platform infra. If errors localized to one service's business logic (NPE, bad input) -> service owner. If in doubt, page the primary on-call and add platform as second-level.

ben: Also check for cross-service blast radius: if multiple services show correlated 500s and the same downstream (eg auth-db) -> infra. If it's a single endpoint -> service. Use the incident triage table in the runbook.

tara: Cool. Can someone do a quick mock incident with me today to exercise PD ack/escalation + creating a PM ticket? Prefer afternoon.

alex: I can do a 30-min mock at 17:00 UTC. Plan: simulate elevated 5xx on payments-service, exercise PD ack, escalate to infra if DB errors show, and sketch a postmortem outline.

oncall-trainer-bot: TRAINING NOTE: After mock, add a line to the training sheet and mark which checklist items were covered. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/training

ben: Small helper snippet for muting noisy alerts during deploy (use sparingly):

```
# Grafana alert mute via CLI (ops only)
grafana-cli mute --alert-id=1234 --duration=15m --reason="deploy-noise" --author=tara
```

ben: Only muting metric-level alerts; do not mute error-budget or availability alerts. Document any mute in the incident and tag the deploy.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: payments-service v2.4.1 scheduled at 2026-04-12T18:30:00Z -> watch for increased 5xx.

tara: Thanks all. @ops-iam let me know when OPS-1229 is done and I'll confirm SMS. See you at 17:00 for the drill.

ops-iam: OPS-1229: added tara's number to exception list and triggered retry for PD verification. Please check PD SMS in ~5m.

tara: SMS verified! I can ack pages now. Thanks everyone, looking forward to the mock. :muscle:
